chains.inputs: Beverage bottle after use. Three components: PET body, HDPE or PP cap, label/sleeve (PVC or OPP)
chains.process: Consumed, discarded in the dry bin or sold at the door
chains.output: Used bottle (mixed with other dry waste)
chains.quality: Rinse; keep caps on; no PVC sleeve
chains.byproducts: Residual liquid; caps and labels travel with the bottle

chains.process: Collect, weigh on calibrated scale, photograph, drain, sort by colour (clear / light blue / green / mixed)
chains.byproducts: Dirty, oily or PVC-sleeved bottles (reject or low grade)

chains.process: Weighbridge in, grade, hydraulic bale (bale ID, weight, grade)
chains.quality: Colour mix, PVC, non-PET share, moisture, bale weight

chains.process: DEBALE; manual/optical sort by colour; remove PVC and non-PET; sort out caps (PP/HDPE), metal rings
chains.byproducts: PP/HDPE caps (sold to polyolefin recyclers), labels, metal, glass, stones

chains.process: Shred/grind; cold wash with friction and water; float-sink (PET sinks, PP/HDPE float)
chains.byproducts: Floating PP/HDPE fraction (separate low-value stream); fines; wash sludge

chains.process: HOT CAUSTIC WASH (caustic soda, ~85-95 C), float-sink, rinse, dry, sort. The PET flake is where the value lies
chains.quality: Flake spec defaults: IV 0.70-0.80 dL/g, moisture <=1%, PVC <=50 ppm, polyolefins <=100 ppm, metals <=20 ppm (buyer overrides)
chains.byproducts: PP/HDPE (caps, labels) float off to cold-wash/low-value stream; spent caustic and label pulp to ETP; glue; fines

chains.process: Melt, filter (60-120 mesh), vacuum degas, pelletise; SSP for food-grade; add masterbatch/colour if needed
chains.quality: IV restored 0.70+, moisture, filtration, black specks

chains.process: Glycolysis or methanolysis gives BHET or DMT + MEG; purify; repolymerise
chains.output: Virgin-quality chips. THIS is where DMT belongs

chains.inputs: rPET chips (or flakes by direct spinning)
chains.process: Dry, melt-spin, draw, crimp, heat-set, cut. Additives: TiO2 delustrant, colour masterbatch, stabilisers. Spin finish is applied to the fibre
chains.output: RPSF (recycled polyester staple fibre), 1.2-15 denier, staple length per order
chains.quality: Denier, tenacity, staple length, colour vs spinner spec
chains.byproducts: Off-spec fibre and waste tow (non-woven/fibre-fill), polymer lumps (back to recyclers), spin-finish mist, ETP sludge

chains.output: Yarn with recycled % by weight per lot
chains.byproducts: Comber noil, droppings, fly and hard waste

chains.output: Shirt / trousers (PO tied to fabric lots)

chains.inputs: Copper wire, cable, motor windings, brass, bronze

chains.quality: Copper to smelter purity; PVC regrind saleable
